sub_limits_waiting_notes: Bariatric Surgery: 24 months waiting period. Personal Accident optional rider in Base Cover Option 2.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured per policy year for admission beyond 24 hours
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Comprehensive cover including room rent, ICU, OT, surgeon/anaesthetist fees, telemedicine, medicines, diagnostics, prosthetics implanted.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to limit specified in Policy Schedule
domiciliary_treatment.notes: Minimum 3 continuous days of treatment required.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to limit specified in Schedule
ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient under Ayurveda/Yoga/Naturopathy/Unani/Siddha/Homeopathy in AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for organ donation expenses
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994. Excludes donor's screening, pre/post hospitalization, complications.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road Ambulance + Air Ambulance + Radio Cab (limits per Schedule)
ambulance_cover.notes: Three tiers: Road Ambulance per hospitalization; Air Ambulance within India; Radio Cab to nearest Hospital/home.

critical_illness_cover.notes: Not standalone benefit; Personal Accident rider available.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited times during Policy Year - Restore Base Sum Insured after claim payment
restoration_benefit.notes: Restored SI available for subsequent claims only. Each restoration ≤ Base SI.

copayment_trigger_notes: Optional Co-payment may be selected per Policy Schedule.
permanent_exclusions: Obesity/Weight Control (Excl06) - waived if Bariatric Surgery benefit opted
Hazardous/Adventure Sports without conformance to safety protocols (Excl09)
notable_exclusions_summary: Health Alpha is a comprehensive hospitalization plan with optional Personal Accident, Critical Illness, Bariatric Surgery, Home Health Care, Modern Treatments add-ons. Covers AYUSH, Domiciliary, Organ Donor, Restore Benefit (unlimited). Adventure sports covered subject to safety protocol compliance. Excludes maternity, infertility, refractive error, and treatment outside India.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA; reimbursement via document submission. Toll-free 18001021111. Modern treatments and home health care available on empanelled provider basis.
available_riders: Section 1: Personal Accident (AD, PTD, PPD, TTD, Home Modification, Child Education, Loan Protector)
Section 2: Hospitalization Cover with optional Road/Air Ambulance, Radio Cab, Organ Donor, Modern Treatments, Home Health Care, Consumables, Restore Benefit, AYUSH, Domiciliary, Bariatric Surgery
